findings: The model identified one Global Political Solutions event and all three frozen gold signals: market_entry, office_opening and leadership_buildout.
It also returned business_expansion. The title explicitly says GPS expands operations into Sub-Sahara Africa, so this is a defensible overlapping label rather than a fabricated event.
The cited title and body passage directly support the company, office launch, market entry and leadership appointment.
The property listing contains no supported Radory company event, and the model correctly returned zero events.
It returned insufficient_evidence instead of assessed with an empty event list even though the listing is understandable enough to assess.
The sector funding roundup does not connect a specific funding event to one of the expansion conditions required by funding_expansion.
The model correctly returned assessed with zero events.
The commercial property listing does not support a named company's relocation, and the model correctly returned zero events.
It returned insufficient_evidence instead of assessed with an empty event list.
The model correctly identified Nestle SA downsizing and cited the passages describing retrenchment notices and severance discussions.
It missed a separate ma_consolidation event: the same cited passage explicitly says Nestle is selling its remaining ice-cream operations to Froneri.
This is a secondary-event recall failure, not missing source context or a passage-indexing failure.
The generic office-relocation advice page contains no company event, and the model correctly returned zero events.
It returned insufficient_evidence instead of assessed with an empty event list.
The model returned assessed with zero events across the recruitment aggregator.

The working gold treats a SoluGrowth Office Manager vacancy as workplace_hiring. The supplied passages name SoluGrowth and describe responsibility for office operations, making the positive classification plausible.
This case remains outside the primary gate because aggregator attribution and signal policy were already designated for manual review.
The short generic facilities-manager search snippet does not identify a supported company event.
The model correctly returned insufficient_evidence with zero events.

aggregate_review.conclusion: Indexed compact extraction is mechanically reliable and conservative on the holdout, but secondary-event recall and assessed-versus-insufficient calibration are not reliable enough to freeze the first-pass contract for production.
